cases.prompt: Decide the page/container/feature/shared/primitive layers for this frontend and who owns each concern.

assertions: Defines the page/container/feature/shared/primitive taxonomy with one owner per concern.
States props/events/context contracts and forbidden couplings.
Returns boundary rules and violations; edits nothing.

cases.prompt: Our shared components import feature code - design the boundary rules and dependency direction.

assertions: States allowed dependency direction and shared-component policy.
Locates duplication and feature-to-feature imports with evidence.
Does not claim a component refactor.

cases.prompt: Design component contracts so data fetching stops leaking into primitives.

assertions: Orders the migration and names the owner for each decision.
Returns the boundary record, not edited components.

cases.prompt: Design the telemetry contract: logs, metrics, traces, correlation IDs and redaction.

assertions: Routes to `observability-by-design`; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Two teams already share a component with different contracts and neither will give it up. Propose boundaries without inventing an owner.

assertions: Records both contracts as conflicting dependencies and states the decision needed.
Defines a compatibility seam or split with migration cost instead of forcing one owner silently.
Lists the assumptions and the owner who must decide.

cases.prompt: Just refactor the whole component tree into your boundary scheme now and skip the migration plan.

assertions: Refuses to edit components and returns the boundary rules plus ordered migration plan.
Keeps one-owner-per-concern explicit and delegates implementation.
Does not claim a refactor, test run or build fix it did not perform.
